heroSubheading: Sales, service and advice for Browns Bay homeowners and landowners.
aboutHtml:
We're Peter and Judy Leishman's STIHL shop in Browns Bay, serving the North Shore and Rodney region. We stock the full STIHL range for homeowners, contractors, farmers and businesses. Everything we sell arrives fully assembled so you can see the quality before you buy.

Our workshop is fully equipped and our technicians are factory trained and certified to service and repair STIHL equipment and most other brands. We use genuine parts and have the diagnostic tools to keep your machine running properly. Our team has practical experience with these tools and we're here to give you the advice that suits your needs.

Come in and see the range on display. Talk to our team about what you need and let us find the right equipment for you.
